title: Fig and the Black Box
note: b414 — Phase 3 complete (air, ure, er) and Phase 4 begins (Learning) — first consonant clusters bl, br, cl, cr.

pages.brief: Fig the caterpillar standing inside a wooden potting shed.
Fig spotting a black wooden box on the floor of the shed.
Close view inside the open black box, full of small red bricks.
Fig the caterpillar straining to lift the heavy black box without success.
Fig the caterpillar carrying one small red brick.
Fig the caterpillar carrying a second and third small red brick, one at a time.
Fig the caterpillar stacking six small red bricks on top of a shelf.
All the red bricks now stacked neatly on top of the shelf, the black box empty.
Fig the caterpillar clapping happily beside the stack of bricks.
